items.title: Proviso Proves Itself with International Audience
items.summary: African Delegation visits Union Pacific Proviso Yard to see first hand "how we railroad in America."

items.title: UP Employees Reach Out with Back to School Barbecue
items.summary: Yard Center Intermodal employees in Dolton, Illinois, held a Back to School Barbecue to collect school supplies and raise funds for Bryant Elementary School in Harvey, Illinois.

items.title: Funds Support Veteran Services Center
items.summary: Honoring the significant presence of military veterans in the UP workforce, the Union Pacific Foundation recently donated $10,000 to the Bellevue University Military and Veteran Services Center (MVSC).

items.title: Rail Pride and Science Connect at Mutec
items.summary: Union Pacific has been working with the Technological Museum of the Federal Electricity Commission (Mutec) on a restoration and preservation program to restore several pieces of equipment.

items.title: UP Now Accepting Safety Grant Applications
items.summary: Community organizations are encouraged to develop multifaceted plans for safety outreach in their communities, and UP may help with funding.

items.title: Blues Man Rocks UP's Dupo Terminal
items.summary: Marquise Knox's "Feel Like Goin' Home" serves as soundtrack for an insider's view of Union Pacific Dupo Terminal operations in the third in a series of four "Listen UP" videos slated to be filmed this year.

items.title: Historic Rotary Snowplow Receives Warm Welcome in Roseville
items.summary: A donation to the city of Roseville, California, rotary snowplow SPMW 7221 takes up residence outside J.R. Davis Yard, at the entrance to downtown.

items.title: Union Pacific Police Pass the Torch
items.summary: Union Pacific special agents recently joined local, county and federal law enforcement agencies to participate in the Law Enforcement Torch Run for Special Olympics in Nebraska and Kansas.

items.title: UP Technology Impacting Cross-Border Security
items.summary: A Railcar Inspection Portal (RIP), which instantly provides a 360-degree view of railcars passing through U.S.-Mexico crossings, recently detected 15 bundles of marijuana near Nogales, Arizona.

items.title: UP Trainees on a 'Mission' to Lend a Hand
items.summary: UP Field Management Trainees, "dedicated to serve," recently volunteered at Omaha's Open Door Mission.

items.title: New Overpass Helps Bridge Communities
items.summary: Aurora and Denver, Colorado, made a clean sweep of barriers and built a bridge between their communities with the Peoria Street Overpass.

items.title: U.S. Energy Renaissance Depends on Safe Rail Transportation
items.summary: “We constantly work to review and improve our safety practices and often exceed federal safety regulations. We recently worked with our industry and the Department of Transportation to implement eight new voluntary safety practices, all of which were effective earlier this week."

items.title: Safety Campaign’s Message: Always Expect a Train
items.summary: "Whether you’re on foot or in your car, this campaign reminds the pedestrians and motorists to keep themselves safe by following railroad safety laws and only crossing at designated grade crossings."

items.title: Husker Nation Turns Out for the Big Red Express
items.summary: A joint celebration between the railroad and the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, the Big Red Express called attention to their shared historical connection with communities across the state.

items.title: Union Pacific On Board for the '10,000 Strong'
items.summary: Thank you, veterans, for your service. UP joins other LA companies as part of the '10,000 Strong Initiative."

items.title: UP's Big Red Express Delivers Husker Pride
items.summary: University of Nebraska coaches will be on-board a UP special, meeting fans from across Nebraska at whistle stops in Columbus, Grand Island, Kearney, and North Platte.

items.title: Twin Cities First Responders Study Hazmat Safety
items.summary: Minutes count in emergency situations, and how to respond effectively and safely in the unlikely event of a chemical incident was just part of the training provided recently to Twin Cities-area first responders.

items.title: UP, Partners Recognized for Arizona Project
items.summary: The desert town of Sahuarita, Arizona, is a growing community that sits along the Santa Cruz River. It's also a railroad town, with track that connects UP's Sunset Route with the important border town of Nogales. The town recently was honored for a great collaborative effort on an important road widening project.

items.title: History Is on Display at Union Pacific's Home Plate
items.summary: Now in its fourth year, Union Pacific's Home Plate has become a tradition of its own. Located just north of the stadium, baseball fans and rail fans can see history on display in the form of Union Pacific's fleet of Heritage cars, some dating back to 1912, each painstakingly restored.

items.title: Earth Day Is For the Birds and More at Union Pacific
items.summary: Flyways and Byways and the protection of migratory birds was the theme of a month-long Earth Day initiative at Union Pacific.

items.title: St. Louis Area First Responders Learn Chemical Transportation Safety and Proper Response Techniques
items.summary: TRANSCAER in St. Louis - A joint effort in educating emergency responders about the safe and secure transportation of materials classified as hazardous.

items.title: San Antonio Spurs and UP Urge Sports Fans to Be Safe
items.summary: Union Pacific and the San Antonio Spurs don't play around when it comes to rail safety.

items.title: Union Pacific Thinking About Back to School
items.summary: It's never too early to think about Back to School Supplies, and helping those in need.

items.title: Checking in with the Boyts
items.summary: Postscript to UP's 150th birthday celebration video remake contest with Brock and Nellie Boyts.

items.title: Government Officials from Both Sides of the Border Help Launch Santa Teresa
items.summary: UP Chairman and CEO Jack Koraleski joined New Mexico Governor Susana Martinez, U.S. Senator Tom Udall, Chihuahua, Mexico, Governor Cesar Duarte and other local officials in launching the new 2,200 acre site, which officially opened April 1.

items.title: Ceremony to Mark Opening of Landmark Facility
items.summary: A golden spike has been used to signify the completion of major new railroad construction projects since the joining of the Transcontinental Railroad back on May 10, 1869. That ceremony is fitting for the opening of the $400 million state-of-the-art facility located in southern New Mexico destined to be a strategic focal point for rail shipments in the southwestern United States.

items.title: Rockin' and Railroading at the Santa Teresa Intermodal Facility
items.summary: The Santa Teresa Intermodal Facility in Santa Teresa, N.M., is featured in the second in a series of four "Listen UP" videos slated to be filmed this year.

items.title: The Startup That Grew From Inside a 152-year-old Fortune 150 Company
items.summary: One of Nebraska's newest software companies looks and sounds like a startup, and it tends to act like one. It's got five young developer employees. Its products are mobile-based and innovative like a lot of startups. Its website looks like any other. The team practices lean principals. But there's something inherently different about Valvora, a software as a service company focusing on human relations and management solutions, among other things.

items.title: UP Committed to Those Who Served
items.summary: UP Executive Vice President and Corporate Secretary Diane Duran and UPVETS present donation of $150,000 to the Warrior Project ® (WWP), during special fiesta in Texas.

items.title: Big Boy Steams Into Utah Ahead of Restoration Project
items.summary: SALT LAKE CITY — The Union Pacific Railroad is getting ready to restore one of the world’s largest steam locomotives, but beforehand they are taking the train on a tour. items.title: Houston Exhibit to Display "Engines of Progress"
items.summary: Big things are happening in Houston, and the UP Foundation is helping them tell the story.

items.title: New Concrete Tie Facility Supports U.S. Railroads
items.summary: These days, the ties that bind are made of concrete, and a new $22 million manufacturing plant in Clinton, Iowa, will be producing 600,000 of them annually.

items.title: Big Boy No. 4014 to Begin Historic Trek to Cheyenne
items.summary: The 1.2 million pound steam locomotive will be towed 1,293 miles by modern diesel-electric UP freight locomotives to UP’s Heritage Fleet Steam Operations headquarters in Cheyenne where it will undergo restoration for the next five years.

items.title: Historic Agreement Reflects Trust Between UP and Confederated Tribes
items.summary: After almost two years of negotiations, Union Pacific and the Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation (CTUIR) reach historical agreements regarding access to railroad land as well as a MOU on joint community policing.

items.title: Armour Yellow and Big Red Team Up for Special Train
items.summary: UP's Armour Yellow shows support for the University of Nebraska-Lincoln with the Big Red Express.

items.title: Illinois & Union Pacific Officials Announce Passenger Service
items.summary: Union Pacific has been working with Illinois Gov. Pat Quinn and the Illinois Department of Transportation to develop passenger service from Chicago to Elgin, Huntley, Belivdere and Rockford beginning in the spring of 2015. The project was announced at a ceremony held in Rockford April 10.

items.title: 'UP's Biggest Fan' Gets the Ride of His Life
items.summary: The tale of Jacob and AJ is much more than the story of a rail fan and one employee.

items.title: Public Opinion Sought as UP Police Department Seeks CALEA Accreditation
items.summary: UP strives to achieve the prestigious recognition of CALEA accreditation, and asks the communities where we live and serve to offer input.

items.title: Enthusiasm, Expertise Surrounds Big Boy Restoration
items.summary: Ed Dickens and a team of Union Pacific steam specialists prepare for the "Holy Grail of steam locomotive restorations."

items.title: UC-Davis Engineering Students Receive Real-Life Rail Perspective
items.summary: Members of the Engineering Clubs at the University of California-Davis recently visited UP's JR Davis Yard in Roseville, and were surprised to learn about the extent of opportunities.

items.title: Making Friends the UP Way
items.summary: Jacob Guasco has a large collection of UP model trains. Now, thanks to Aamund Bouvia, he's got some great memories, too.

items.title: Cultural Center Project on Track after Flooding
items.summary: Recovery and rebuilding after last year's flooding in Evans, Colo., includes a new library and cultural center.

items.summary: The arrival of UP No. 3105 locomotive to RailGiants Museum was a cause of both celebration and ceremony.

items.title: UP No. 3105 Heads Home to RailGiants Museum
items.summary: The donated equipment will become part of the museum's mission to promote the preservation and documentation of all facets of railroading.

items.title: Palatine Honored with Safety Spike Award
items.summary: The Palatine Police Department of the Village of Palatine received the Union Pacific Safety Spike Award in recognition of going above and beyond the call of duty to promote railroad safety in their community.

items.title: Union Pacific Hosts Omaha's First Red Dress Dash
items.summary: More than 300 women and men decked out in red dresses gathered at Union Pacific Center (UPC) Feb. 6 to participate in Omaha's first Red Dress Dash, a national event that benefitted the American Heart Association.

items.title: UP Employee's Aid Organization Expands Globally
items.summary: UP employee Saikou Camara founded the nonprofit Your Change for a Change organization, which has expanded globally from the United States to Sweden to The Gambia.

items.title: Union Pacific Input Helps Shape Colorado Bill
items.summary: Commmunity safety is at the heart of Special Agent's testimony regarding Colorado Senate Bill 14-049.

items.title: Honoring Those Who Served
items.summary: UP VET Tom Demayo and his involvement in the WWII veterans Honor Flight program.

items.title: Fans Welcome Big Boy No. 4014’s Return to the National Rail Network
items.summary: It was a historic day for Union Pacific’s steam program. After months of preparation, UP’s Big Boy No. 4014 returned to the national rail network in the early morning hours of Jan. 26, 2014, to the applause of the hundreds of rail fans on hand to experience the moment.
